nuggets.text: The Cavaliers' 34-8 opening win over NC State was the 700th victory in program history.
The Cavaliers' opener featured a 23-play, 75-yard scoring drive that lasted 12:15, both program records.
Beau Pribula ran for 110 yards and went 9-of-11 passing with two touchdowns in his Cavaliers debut.
Beau Pribula was a Missouri quarterback last season, sat out its Gator Bowl loss to Virginia, and now starts for the Cavaliers.
Cavaliers coach Tony Elliott earned an industrial engineering degree and worked as an engineer for Michelin before coaching.
Cavaliers coach Tony Elliott walked on at Clemson as a receiver and was named team captain in 2003.
The Cavaliers won 11 games for the first time in program history last season, finishing 11-3.
Fans at Scott Stadium sing the Good Old Song, set to 'Auld Lang Syne,' after every Cavaliers score.
Cavaliers kicker Will Bettridge has 327 career points, just five shy of Connor Hughes's school record.
Cavaliers punter Daniel Sparks boomed a 63-yard punt in the opener, his school-record 16th career punt of 60-plus yards.
